decisions.reason: The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the core construction-repair offer and needs few extra resources, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The multi-model transfer pump line uses core conveying competence and in-house manufacturing, and its likely satisfactory performance in a growing market makes withdrawal unwarranted.
Fire protection flow monitoring fits the digitalization strategy and has its own page, so despite uncertain adoption the firm's slack lets it carry the product longer.
The hydraulic two-component sprayer was only launched in 2024 and is close to the established offer, so dropping it before results can be judged against aspirations would be premature.
